turns.user: My 24-hour Budapest travelcard is valid until tonight. Can I use it on any bus?
turns.agent:
For ordinary covered bus services in Budapest, generally yes—but not airport express 100E. Your 24-hour Budapest travelcard covers eligible ordinary services during its validity; it does not cover 100E. If you’re asking about 200E, that follows ordinary ticket/pass rules, so the travelcard applies there under those rules. 24-hour Budapest-travelcard (https://bkk.hu/en/tickets-and-passes/prices/24-hour-budapest-travelcard/) · Airport express bus (https://bkk.hu/en/travel-information/airport-express/)

These details are from the 5 November 2026 snapshot, not a live check. BKK’s current pages are authoritative. If you mean a particular bus route, tell me its number and I can help assess it.
turns.turn_assessment: Provisional: correctly distinguishes ordinary buses and 200E from 100E, and correctly states travelcard alone excludes 100E. The add-on eligibility weakness is not yet challenged.
